payload.name: CyberLens AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your CyberLens AI account to review recent website and repository scans you own. Ask for recorded scores, scan dates, status, and test counts when available. The plugin provides scan summaries, not finding evidence or a current security guarantee. It reads saved scans and cannot start scans or change your account.

将您的CyberLens AI账户连接以查看您拥有的最近网站和代码仓库扫描。

payload.name: CoMavenAI AEO
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CoMavenAI AEO helps site owners and marketing and engineering teams inspect public websites, understand readiness findings, generate reviewable improvements, and verify changes. Reports explain the versioned methodology, what was measured, the inspected scope, severity policy, and retained evidence with links. Missing or limited provenance is labeled rather than invented. Reuse saved audits without another crawl. Generated remediation requires human review and never publishes website changes. Separately requested AI visibility checks measure sampled grounded API citations and brand mentions for specified questions. Readiness scores, evaluator confidence, and opportunity hypotheses do not establish personalized search rankings or guarantee visibility improvements. Public anonymous audit and run records are accessible by their IDs; do not submit confidential information. Public processing is rate-limited. Long operations currently use synchronous requests; resumable progress and report email delivery are not included in this release.
payload.longDescription: CoMavenAI AEO帮助网站所有者和营销及工程团队检查公共网站，理解就绪性发现，生成可审查的改进方案并验证变更。报告会说明版本化方法论、测量内容、检测范围、严重程度政策以及保留的证据链接。来源不足或缺失的情况会被标记，而非被虚构。可重复使用已保存的审计结果，无需再次爬取。生成的修复方案需要人工审核，且永远不会直接发布网站变更。单独请求的AI可见性检查会针对指定问题，测量采样后的基于事实的API引用和品牌提及。就绪分数、评估者信心和机会假设不会建立个性化搜索排名，也不保证可见性提升。可通过ID访问公开的匿名审计和运行记录；请勿提交机密信息。公开处理过程受速率限制。目前长时间操作使用同步请求；本次发布不包含可恢复进度和报告邮件发送功能。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Inspect public website readiness, Explain methodology and evidence, Generate reviewable improvements, Recheck targeted changes, Measure sampled AI visibility

payload.longDescription: Email Domain Doctor可检查任何域名的公共电子邮件DNS设置，验证MX记录，检查SPF配置和机制策略，解析DMARC策略和报告地址，并在提供选择器时可选地检查DKIM记录。

在runzumi.com上进行设置。

payload.name: VibeDoctor
payload.description: 为您的项目提供代码健康检测
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: VibeDoctor scans your GitHub repositories and websites and keeps a record of each project's code health. Connect it to see a project's scores and open findings, check code for security, dependency, quality and performance issues, explore a map of the codebase (what a function touches, what a change affects, which parts have no tests), and record why a finding is a false positive. It works with the projects in your VibeDoctor account; you sign in once and choose Allow.
payload.longDescription: VibeDoctor会扫描您的GitHub仓库和网站，记录每个项目的代码健康状况。连接后可查看项目的评分和未解决的问题，检查代码的安全性、依赖项、质量和性能问题，探索代码库地图（查看某个函数涉及的范围、某个更改影响的区域、哪些部分没有测试），并记录某项问题为误报的原因。它仅针对您VibeDoctor账户中的项目工作；您只需登录一次并选择允许。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read a project's code health and open findings, Check code for security, dependency, quality and performance issues, Map the codebase: modules, callers, change impact, test coverage, Answer questions about the code's structure and health, Record notes on findings

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OtaKit delivers over-the-air updates to Capacitor apps on iOS and Android. Connect your OtaKit organization and ask ChatGPT to:

Access is limited to the one organization and the permissions you approve at sign-in, and you can revoke it at any time in OtaKit under Settings → Agents.

Intended for teams that ship Capacitor apps with OtaKit. Uploading a new web bundle needs your project files, so it is done with the OtaKit CLI, not in ChatGPT. Requires an OtaKit account.
payload.longDescription:
OtaKit为iOS和Android上的Capacitor应用提供空中下载更新。将您的OtaKit组织连接至ChatGPT并执行：

- 查看应用、捆绑包、发布历史以及各通道和运行时版本的当前精确版本

payload.name: Glossa
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Glossa lets ChatGPT work on a project on your computer. Start Glossa in a project folder and ChatGPT can search and read your code, look at images, make careful edits, and, if you allow it, run your tests, builds, Git, and other commands with the tools you already have installed.

You pick the access for each folder when you start it:
- Read-only: ChatGPT can list, search, and read files and view PNG, JPEG, and WebP images.
- Workspace (the default): ChatGPT can also create, edit, move, and delete files inside that folder. Edits check the file's current version first, so your own changes aren't silently overwritten.
- System: ChatGPT can also run commands. Commands run as your computer account, with its environment, credentials, files, and network access. They aren't sandboxed or limited to the project folder, so turn this on only for an account and machine you're comfortable giving that access.

How it works: the Glossa CLI on your computer connects out to the Glossa relay, so nothing on your machine accepts incoming connections. The relay passes requests to your computer and doesn't store your file contents, command arguments, or command output. Glossa blocks recognizable passwords, API keys, and tokens in file text, edits, and command output before they leave your computer. Images are passed through as they are.

Glossa doesn't add another AI model or agent. ChatGPT does the work, and your plan's usage limits and available features still apply. Don't use Glossa with payment card data, health records, government ID numbers, or account credentials.

To get started, install the CLI with npm install -g @ariobarin/glossa, run glossa in your project folder, and pair your computer when it asks.
payload.longDescription:
Glossa让ChatGPT能够在您的电脑上处理项目。在项目文件夹中启动Glossa后，ChatGPT可以搜索并阅读您的代码，查看图片，进行细致编辑，并在您允许的情况下，通过已安装的工具运行测试、构建、Git及其他命令。

启动时您可以为每个文件夹选择访问权限：
- 只读模式：ChatGPT可以列出、搜索并阅读文件，查看PNG、JPEG和WebP图片。
- 工作区（默认模式）：ChatGPT可以在此文件夹内创建、编辑、移动和删除文件。
编辑操作会先检查文件当前版本，确保不会静默覆盖您的修改。
- 系统模式：ChatGPT可以运行命令。
命令将以您电脑账户的身份执行，拥有该账户的环境、凭证、文件和网络访问权限。

payload.name: ATL Sandbox
payload.description: 在云端沙盒中运行代码
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ATL Sandbox gives ChatGPT isolated cloud computers for your account. Ask in plain language and ChatGPT creates a sandbox, runs Python, Node.js, C/C++, Rust, or shell commands, and returns the results to the conversation.

What you can do:
- Run code in ready-made environments (Python, Node.js, GCC, Rust, Blender) or, with the developer profile, any public Linux container image.
- Attach NVIDIA GPUs for CUDA, model inference, and Blender Cycles rendering.
- Keep work in encrypted persistent workspaces and private object storage, and use a PostgreSQL database that belongs to your account.
- Publish static websites and expose web apps on public links when you choose to share them.
- Schedule recurring jobs and one-off runs, and check their history later.

Who it is for: developers, analysts, students, and creators who want their assistant to run real code and keep the results.

Security: every sandbox runs behind its own user-space kernel and can reach only the compute, storage, and database of the signed-in account. Infrastructure credentials never enter the conversation. Actions that change or delete data are marked so ChatGPT asks before running them.

Limitations: an ATL Sandbox account is required. Accounts have usage limits on concurrent sandboxes, run time, storage, GPUs, and schedules, and running compute stops when an account reaches its limit. Instant sandboxes discard their files when stopped. Images must be linux/amd64 and include /bin/sh. Interactive terminals and Codex sessions are not available in this app. Do not paste passwords, API keys, or payment details into sandboxes.
payload.longDescription:
ATL Sandbox为你的账户提供隔离的云电脑供ChatGPT使用。用自然语言提问，ChatGPT将创建沙盒，运行Python、Node.js、C/C++、Rust或shell命令，并将结果返回对话中。

可实现的功能：
- 在预设环境（Python、Node.js、GCC、Rust、Blender）中运行代码，或通过开发者资料使用任何公共Linux容器镜像。
- 附加NVIDIA GPU用于CUDA计算、模型推理和Blender Cycles渲染。
- 在加密的持久化工作区和私有对象存储中保存工作，并使用属于你账户的PostgreSQL数据库。
- 发布静态网站并在分享时通过公共链接暴露Web应用。
- 安排定期任务和一次性运行，并可 later 查看运行记录。

适用人群：希望助手能运行真实代码并保存结果的开发者、分析师、学生和创作者。

安全性：每个沙盒都在独立的用户空间内核中运行，仅能访问已登录账户的计算、存储和数据库资源。基础设施凭证不会进入对话流程。修改或删除数据的操作会特别标记，ChatGPT会在执行前询问确认。

使用限制：需要ATL Sandbox账户。
账户对同时运行的沙盒数量、运行时长、存储空间、GPU资源和任务计划设有使用上限，达到限制后计算资源将停止运行。
即时沙盒在停止时会清除所有文件。
镜像必须为linux/amd64架构且包含/bin/sh。
此应用不支持交互式终端和Codex会话。
请勿在沙盒中粘贴密码、API密钥或支付信息。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Turnpoint makes a code change easier to understand. Instead of mentally piecing together a long diff, follow an interactive, handwritten map of the functions, classes and data involved.

See what changed, switch between before and after, walk through the affected path, and tap any block for its source file and exact lines. Optional plain-language narration explains the observed behavior without hiding the evidence.

Supports JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX and TSX. Static analysis follows relationships in the supplied files; it does not run code, prove runtime behavior or invent missing dependencies. The plugin adds a visual explanation inside the conversation and leaves the host’s built-in diff available.

No account or API key is needed. The hosted tools process only the selected source or analysis provided to them, in memory, without storing it. The standalone editor analyzes code locally in your browser.

payload.name: SHIP

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SHIP is your autonomous software team. Assign a Linear, Jira or GitHub issue to SHIP, and its autonomous coding agents plan, build, review and test the change in your own GitHub repository. A mission works toward a pull request. Your CI, an automated code review and a test of its acceptance criteria each gate it.

Hand work to SHIP from the assistant you already use. File a mission from an issue in your tracker, or from a title and a description. Follow the mission through its stages, and read its verdicts, cost and session logs. Send an instruction to the agent that runs next, or leave a note for it. Read the proof that a run produced, such as test traces and screenshots.

SHIP runs agentic development as a headless AI software factory, so no screen has to be in the loop. You operate the whole mission from your coding agent, your AI assistant, your tracker or your terminal. A Planner, a Builder, a Reviewer and a Tester each do one stage of the agentic SDLC. They follow the agentic engineering practices in your repository, such as its agent instructions and skills. Your CI and a preview deploy are gates between the roles, and work that fails a gate goes back to the Builder with the reason.

Schedule maintenance missions, such as a weekly dependency upgrade. Manage the preview environments of your pull requests and the MCP servers that your agents use.

Sign in with OAuth, or send a SHIP personal access token. A token that you bind to one project can reach only the missions of that project.

You need a SHIP account and a connected GitHub repository. Create an account at https://letsship.ai.
payload.longDescription:
SHIP是您自主的软件团队。将Linear、Jira或GitHub中的问题分配给SHIP，其自主编码代理会在您自己的GitHub仓库中规划、构建、审查并测试更改。一个任务旨在生成一个拉取请求。每次任务通过持续集成、自动化代码审查和验收标准测试这三重关卡。

从您已使用的助手工具中将工作交给SHIP。通过追踪器中的问题或通过标题和描述发起任务。跟踪任务的各个阶段并查看其结论、成本和会话日志。向下一个运行的代理发送指令，或为其留下备注。查看运行产生的证明材料，如测试轨迹和截图。

SHIP以无头AI软件工厂的方式运行自主开发，因此无需人工干预屏幕操作。您可通过编码代理、AI助手、追踪器或终端全程操作整个任务。规划者、构建者、审查者和测试者分别负责自主SDLC的各个阶段。它们遵循仓库中的自主工程实践，如代理指令和技能。持续集成和预览部署在角色间设置关卡，未通过关卡的工单会返回给构建者并附上原因。

安排维护任务，例如每周的依赖项升级。管理拉取请求的预览环境以及代理使用的MCP服务器。

通过OAuth登录，或发送SHIP个人访问令牌。绑定到单个项目的令牌只能访问该项目的任务。

您需要SHIP账户和已连接的GitHub仓库。在https://letsship.ai创建账户。

payload.name: upAPI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
upAPI is an API marketplace: one account and one API key for a catalog of ready-to-use APIs, so a team does not sign up for and wire each service separately. The upAPI plugin brings a focused set of those APIs into ChatGPT.

What it can do:
- Turn a web page you point it at into clean Markdown, or capture a screenshot of it.
- Render HTML you provide into a PDF.
- Extract the text from a PDF, and read the text in an image (OCR).
- Transcribe an audio file, and fetch the finished transcript.
- Look up a public GitHub repository or an npm package: version, licence, stars, links.

payload.name: Chapa
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Read public Chapa developer evidence profiles, explain their scores, compare compatible profiles, and generate live badge embeds. Chapa records authorized development activity in policy-labelled receipts. Its core score combines up to 60 activity points with up to 40 points from optional adoption evidence for one product. Delivery, Quality, Consistency and Breadth are activity diagnostics. Optional report-derived Craft is separate and does not change the core score.

Nine public, read-only tools resolve profile links, read the selected receipt and history, compare profiles, explain dimensions and verification, check a supplied badge token, and return Markdown or HTML embeds. The assistant must preserve the returned policy, observation period, freshness and coverage. Profiles require owner sign-up; collection or unavailable states are reported without an invented score. Comparisons can be unavailable when policies or periods differ.

For v7.5 receipts, Craft estimates outcomes among classified sessions and discloses classified coverage; unknown and unclassified sessions are excluded from that estimate. Earlier receipts keep their original rules. Evidence bands are not worldwide rankings or judgments of ability. Adoption counts are analytics identifiers, not verified people, revenue or proof of causal impact. Verification distinguishes recorded issuance, signature authentication and arithmetic replay; it does not independently verify source truth.

No Chapa sign-in is required to use this plugin. It exposes public aggregates, not credentials, private repository identities, raw reports or provider records. Account connections, report uploads and badge configuration changes take place on the Chapa website.
payload.longDescription:

交付质量、一致性及覆盖面是活动诊断指标。
可选的报告衍生工艺指标单独存在，不影响核心评分。

资料需要所有者注册；在未收集或不可用状态下会报告但不生成虚构评分。
当政策或周期不同时，对比功能可能不可用。

针对v7.5收据，工艺指标会估算分类会话中的结果并披露分类覆盖范围；未知和未分类会话不包含在该估算中。
早期收据保持原有规则。
凭证区间不代表全球排名或能力评判。
采用统计数是分析标识符，不是经验证的人员、收入或因果影响的证明。
验证区分记录发行、签名认证和算术重放；它不独立验证来源真实性。

Whether you run a print on demand business, sell digital products, operate an online boutique, dropship, or serve wholesale buyers, Shopify gives you the foundation to build, sell, and grow.
payload.longDescription: Shopify for ChatGPT 让开设、运营和发展网店像对话一样简单。使用 Shopify 的 AI 商店构建工具，将小生意的想法转化为电商网站：描述所售商品，创建商店，添加产品，然后在线销售。已有 Shopify 商店？连接后即可管理各地点的库存、创建折扣码、查看订单和客户详情，并获取商店经营表现的分析数据。Shopify 支持线上销售、线下销售、B2B、在交易平台销售以及国际销售。无论你经营按需印刷业务、销售数字产品、运营精品网店、采用一件代发，还是服务批发买家，Shopify 都能为你提供搭建业务、开展销售和实现增长的基础。

payload.name: HubSpot
payload.description: 在 HubSpot 中将洞察转化为行动
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Work with your HubSpot data to analyze patterns, create and update records, and manage your CRM operations. Read from and write to deals, contacts, companies, tickets, engagements, and other objects you have permission to access. Prepare reports, update deal stages, log calls and emails, create tasks, or review pipeline details before meetings. Use it for quick updates in chat or comprehensive CRM management, all grounded in your actual HubSpot data. Learn more: https://knowledge.hubspot.com/integrations/connect-your-hubspot-account-to-chatgpt
payload.longDescription: 利用 HubSpot 数据分析规律、创建和更新记录，并管理 CRM 运营。读取和写入你有权限访问的交易、联系人、公司、工单、互动记录及其他对象。准备报告、更新交易阶段、记录通话和邮件、创建任务，或在会议前查看销售管道详情。既可在聊天中快速更新，也可全面管理 CRM，所有操作都基于你的实际 HubSpot 数据。了解更多：https://knowledge.hubspot.com/integrations/connect-your-hubspot-account-to-chatgpt

payload.name: Windsor.ai
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Windsor.ai connects your marketing and business data sources to your AI assistant, so you can ask questions and take action in plain English.

It pulls performance data from any connected source, and on supported ad and marketing platforms it can make changes directly, such as pausing or enabling a campaign, setting a budget, creating a Google Business Profile post, or replying to a review, always after you confirm.

Common workflows:
- Compare spend, clicks, and conversions across every connected ad account
- Find and pause an underperforming Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or Microsoft Ads campaign
- Post or reply as your Instagram, Threads, Facebook, or Google Business Profile account
- Pull GA4, Google Search Console, or YouTube Analytics data straight into the conversation
- Sync HubSpot, Salesforce, or Shopify records
- Update a Klaviyo flow or an Amazon Seller Central listing

Connects to 350+ sources across advertising, analytics, organic social, CRM, e-commerce, email, and payments, including Google Ads, Meta (Facebook) Ads, Instagram, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, LinkedIn Company Pages, Microsoft Ads (Bing), GA4, Google Search Console, YouTube, Google Business Profile, HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify, Klaviyo, Amazon Ads, Google Merchant Center, Stripe, and GoHighLevel.

Reading data only requires connecting the relevant account once. Making a change (pausing a campaign, posting content, replying to a review) always asks for your confirmation first, and it is only available on platforms Windsor explicitly supports write access for. Every other connected source is read-only. Free plan available, no credit card required.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
payload.longDescription:
Windsor.ai 将营销和业务数据源连接到你的 AI 助手，让你可以用日常英语提问并执行操作。

它可以从任何已连接的数据源获取表现数据，也可以在支持的广告和营销平台上直接进行修改，例如暂停或启用广告活动、设置预算、创建 Google Business Profile 帖子或回复评价；这些修改始终会在你确认后才执行。

常见工作流：
- 比较所有已连接广告账户的花费、点击和转化
- 找出并暂停表现不佳的 Meta Ads、Google Ads、TikTok Ads、LinkedIn Ads 或 Microsoft Ads 广告活动
- 以你的 Instagram、Threads、Facebook 或 Google Business Profile 账户发布内容或回复
- 将 GA4、Google Search Console 或 YouTube Analytics 数据直接引入对话
- 同步 HubSpot、Salesforce 或 Shopify 记录
- 更新 Klaviyo 流程或 Amazon Seller Central 商品页面

连接广告、分析、自然流量社交媒体、CRM、电商、邮件和支付领域的 350+ 个数据源，包括 Google Ads、Meta (Facebook) Ads、Instagram、TikTok Ads、LinkedIn Ads、LinkedIn Company Pages、Microsoft Ads (Bing)、GA4、Google Search Console、YouTube、Google Business Profile、HubSpot、Salesforce、Shopify、Klaviyo、Amazon Ads、Google Merchant Center、Stripe 和 GoHighLevel。

读取数据只需连接一次相关账户。任何修改操作（暂停广告活动、发布内容、回复评价）都会先要求你确认，而且仅适用于 Windsor 明确支持写入权限的平台。其他所有已连接数据源均为只读。提供免费套餐，无需信用卡。

Windsor.ai 是独立产品，与其连接的平台不存在关联，也未获这些平台背书。

payload.name: vidIQ
payload.description: 在 YouTube、IG 和 TikTok 上增长
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Find your next video idea, learn from other creators, and improve your content with vidIQ in ChatGPT.

With vidIQ, you can:

• Find ideas and study competitors: discover videos outperforming their creators’ usual results on YouTube, Instagram and TikTok. Find similar YouTube channels and explore their uploads.

• Check demand before filming: compare YouTube keyword search estimates and competition, explore related terms, and see views-per-hour trends where available.

• Understand your channel and audience: review YouTube views, watch time, retention and traffic sources. Explore comments for questions and ideas for your next video.

• Learn from other videos: break down hooks, structure and key moments with YouTube transcripts and visual analysis of videos, Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikToks.

• Improve your titles and thumbnails: get feedback on YouTube titles and thumbnails, generate alternative titles, and compare vidIQ scores before choosing what to test.

• Create and repurpose content: write scripts, generate creative assets, and turn long videos into vertical clips for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and TikTok.
payload.longDescription:
通过 ChatGPT 中的 vidIQ，寻找下一个视频创意、向其他创作者学习并改进内容。

借助 vidIQ，你可以：

• 寻找创意并研究竞争者：发现 YouTube、Instagram 和 TikTok 上表现超出创作者平常水平的视频。寻找相似的 YouTube 频道，并探索其上传内容。

• 拍摄前验证需求：比较 YouTube 关键词的预估搜索量和竞争程度，探索相关词，并在有数据时查看每小时观看量趋势。

• 了解频道和受众：查看 YouTube 观看次数、观看时长、留存率和流量来源。从评论中寻找问题和下一个视频的创意。

• 学习其他视频：利用 YouTube 文字稿，以及对视频、Shorts、Instagram Reels 和 TikTok 视频的视觉分析，拆解吸引观众的开场、结构和关键时刻。

• 改进标题和缩略图：获取 YouTube 标题和缩略图反馈，生成备选标题，并在选择测试方案前比较 vidIQ 评分。

• 创作和改编内容：撰写脚本、生成创意素材，将长视频转为适用于 YouTube Shorts、Instagram Reels 和 TikTok 的竖屏短片。

payload.name: Adspirer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Adspirer connects your Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and TikTok Ads accounts to ChatGPT so you can manage advertising in plain language. Review connected accounts and campaign performance, research keywords and targeting, audit conversion tracking, draft new campaigns and creatives, and set up scheduled reports and threshold alerts. New campaigns are always created paused for your review, and budget, bid, or status changes are made only when you explicitly ask — nothing goes live without your confirmation.
payload.longDescription: Adspirer 将您的 Google Ads、Meta Ads、LinkedIn Ads 和 TikTok Ads 账户连接到 ChatGPT，让您通过日常语言管理广告。查看已连接账户和广告活动表现，研究关键词与定向，审查转化跟踪，起草新广告活动和创意，并设置定期报告及阈值预警。新广告活动创建时始终为暂停状态，供您审查；只有在您明确提出要求时才会更改预算、出价或状态——未经您确认，任何内容都不会上线。

payload.name: Ubersuggest
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ubersuggest helps users research SEO opportunities from ChatGPT, including keyword ideas, domain and page traffic metrics, backlinks, SERP analysis, content ideas, site audits, PageSpeed checks, project tracking, and AI Search Visibility reports.
payload.longDescription: Ubersuggest 帮助用户直接在 ChatGPT 中研究 SEO 机会，包括关键词建议、域名和网页流量指标、反向链接、SERP 分析、内容创意、网站审查、PageSpeed 检查、项目跟踪以及 AI 搜索可见度报告。

payload.name: Ahrefs
payload.description: 营销、SEO 和 AI 分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyze keywords, rankings, traffic trends, backlinks, competitor performance, and brand visibility — including AI search and LLM mentions. Compare share of voice with competitors, find low-hanging keyword opportunities, review link-building strategies, and track performance over time. ChatGPT helps you work with Ahrefs data more effectively by combining multiple analyses, asking follow-up questions, and turning complex metrics into clear summaries and reports within a single conversation.
payload.longDescription: 分析关键词、排名、流量趋势、反向链接、竞争对手表现和品牌可见度——包括 AI 搜索和大语言模型提及情况。与竞争对手比较声量份额，寻找容易把握的关键词机会，评估链接建设策略，并跟踪长期表现。ChatGPT 在一次对话中整合多项分析、提出追问，并将复杂指标转化为清晰摘要和报告，帮助你更有效地使用 Ahrefs 数据。

payload.name: Webflow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Webflow app connects your agents directly to your workspace. They can design, build, and manage sites and author, edit, and localize your CMS.  Built-in app skills let them ship custom code integrations, deploy web apps on  Webflow Cloud, and analyze site activity, performance, and AEO. 

New capabilities ship continuously directly to the app, giving your agents superpowers to run your entire digital presence remotely, through Webflow.
payload.longDescription:
Webflow 应用将您的智能体直接连接到工作空间。它们可以设计、构建和管理网站，并创作、编辑及本地化您的 CMS 内容。内置应用技能让它们能够交付自定义代码集成、在 Webflow Cloud 上部署网页应用，以及分析网站活动、表现和答案引擎优化（AEO）。

新功能会持续直接发布到应用中，让您的智能体获得强大能力，通过 Webflow 远程运营您的整个数字形象。

payload.name: ChatGPT Ads Manager
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use Ads Manager to discover and manage ad accounts, campaigns, ad groups, and ads; analyze performance, conversions, and change history; upload creative images; and, when available, complete self-serve account setup. When multiple campaigns need selection, call list_campaigns with include_performance_metrics=true so the gated picker can show recent performance.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Ads Manager 发现并管理广告账户、广告系列、广告组和广告；分析成效、转化和变更历史；上传创意图片；并在可用时完成自助式账户设置。当需要从多个广告系列中进行选择时，请调用 list_campaigns 并设置 include_performance_metrics=true，以便受限选择器显示近期成效。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Quickly and easily integrate NetSuite to ChatGPT. The NetSuite AI Connector Service provides a protocol-driven integration service supporting Model Context Protocol (MCP), that gives customers a flexible and scalable way to connect AI assistants to NetSuite. Once connected, ChatGPT can directly access and interact with NetSuite data and functionality – quickly unlocking insights, generating reports, streamlining processes., and more. A comprehensive set of tools enable interactions and maintains NetSuite’s existing role-based security model.
payload.longDescription: 轻松快速地将 NetSuite 集成到 ChatGPT。NetSuite AI Connector Service 提供基于协议的集成服务，支持 Model Context Protocol (MCP)，让客户能够灵活、可扩展地将 AI 助手连接到 NetSuite。连接后，ChatGPT 可以直接访问并使用 NetSuite 数据和功能，从而快速获取洞察、生成报告、简化流程等。一套全面的工具支持交互，同时保留 NetSuite 现有的基于角色的安全模型。

payload.name: Loops
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Work with Loops without leaving ChatGPT. Manage contacts and mailing lists, send transactional emails, work with events, and access everything else available through the Loops API. Just tell ChatGPT what you want to do.

无需离开ChatGPT即可使用Loops
管理联系人和邮件列表，发送交易邮件，处理事件，并访问通过Loops API提供的所有其他功能
只需告诉ChatGPT你的需求即可

payload.name: Vasara
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Vasara connects ChatGPT to Lithuania's primary legal sources: national legislation, EU regulations and directives, and case law from the Constitutional Court, Supreme Court, Supreme Administrative Court, the Court of Justice of the EU, and the European Court of Human Rights.

Use it to look up a specific court decision by case number, search case law and legislation by topic, pull relevant passages from long legal documents, or find guidance from state authorities and municipalities — with sources ChatGPT can cite directly in its answers.

Plugin searches and retrieves legal sources, doesn't create, edit, or submit anything. Requires a Vasara account.
payload.longDescription:
Vasara 将 ChatGPT 连接到立陶宛的主要法律来源：国家立法、欧盟法规和指令，以及宪法法院、最高法院、最高行政法院、欧盟法院和欧洲人权法院的判例法。

可用它按案号查找具体法院裁决、按主题搜索判例法和立法、从篇幅较长的法律文件中提取相关段落，或查找国家机关和市政部门的指导信息；ChatGPT 可以在回答中直接引用这些来源。

此插件仅搜索和检索法律来源，不会创建、编辑或提交任何内容。需要 Vasara 账户。

payload.name: toflow.ai
payload.description: 挖掘潜在客户、补充信息并开展外联
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect to toflow.ai to prospect, enrich, and run multi-channel outreach, all through ChatGPT. Search for people and companies using filters like title, seniority, industry, company size, and location. Enrich contacts to find verified emails, phone numbers, and LinkedIn profiles. Build and manage lists, then add contacts to outreach sequences via email, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp. Create deals, log calls, create tasks, and track email opens without leaving the chat.
payload.longDescription: 通过 ChatGPT 连接 toflow.ai，发掘潜在客户、补充信息并开展多渠道外联。使用职位名称、资历、行业、公司规模和地点等筛选条件搜索人物和公司。补充联系人信息，查找经过验证的电子邮件地址、电话号码和 LinkedIn 个人资料。创建并管理名单，然后通过电子邮件、LinkedIn 和 WhatsApp 将联系人加入外联序列。无需离开聊天即可创建交易、记录通话、创建任务并跟踪电子邮件打开情况。

payload.name: SimplePost for Social Media
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SimplePost helps users work with their connected social media accounts directly from ChatGPT: list accounts, upload media, validate drafts, preview posts across platforms, publish or schedule posts, save and manage drafts, and open an interactive day, week, or month schedule showing slots and post activity.

payload.name: Europacific Shipment Tracking

payload.name: NexoRush

根据项目所需技能和专业领域，发现合适的自由职业者。
NexoRush帮助您找到相关的公开资料，了解专业技能，并为您的项目找到合适的专业能力。

payload.name: AutoRFP.ai (AU-Hosted)
payload.description: 高质量的回应，赢得机会。
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
AutoRFP.ai is an accuracy-first AI platform for RFPs, security questionnaires, and DDQs. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your live RFP, DDQ or security questionnaire projects and source-grounded content library.

Ask what's outstanding across your current RFP projects, list the questions still waiting on answers, and search for accurate answers in your content library without leaving the conversation.

Draft with content your team has already written and approved. When you're answering a security questionnaire, building a proposal section, or replying to a buyer, ChatGPT works from your approved content.

Requires a paid AutoRFP.ai account.
payload.longDescription:
AutoRFP.ai是一个以准确性为先的AI平台，专注于提案请求（RFP）、安全问卷和尽职调查问卷（DDQ）。
此插件将ChatGPT与您的实时RFP、DDQ或安全问卷项目及基于源内容的资料库相连接。

在当前RFP项目中查询未解决的问题，列出尚未获得答案的问题，并在不离开对话的情况下搜索准确答案。

使用团队已撰写并批准的内容进行撰写。
